name: mike · religion de carga · identidad v6
instructions: Create draft, search reuse, complete source/style/scale fields, adopt only after validation. Technical success is not artistic acceptance.

production.prompt: Identity-preserving production game sprites derived from the attached canonical character. The EXACT youthful adult male elf Mike: blue eyes, long blond hair tied behind, pointed ears, blue robe with detailed gold trim, BLACK gloves, black boots, red-brown gold spellbook, sheathed dagger. Do not feminize, change face or use chibi proportions. His book is deliberately secured in its belt pouch whenever BOTH hands work; otherwise keep it in his anatomical LEFT arm. Gloves stay black in every pose. Eight chronological reading/story poses with a small gold-embossed religious reference book physically held by the hands in every pose: 1 neutral reading, 2 turns page, 3 compares symbol unseen to right, 4 holds open book forward showing simple gold sun emblem, 5 respectful smile and small nod still with book, 6 puzzled, 7 turns book upside down, 8 confused calm holding book. No glow, divine effects, rewards or powers. Feet fixed. Fixed southeast three-quarter view of hero facing RIGHT, exactly the canonical face, proportions, costume, palette and pixel-painted rendering of the reference, no redesign. A regular EXACT FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, eight complete isolated frames in reading order. ALL figures fully visible inside their cells with generous transparent safety margins. Constant body scale in all frames, shortened crouched silhouette is NOT a smaller person. Landscape 2:1 sheet, each cell contains only the hero. Real transparent background; no ground, shadows, labels, numbers, borders or text. High detail at native size, ideally 350+ pixels for standing human figure per cell. Do not use old loading-character designs.
